results.question: What experience do you have with AI?
results.answer:
Worked as a Full Stack Engineer focused on AI claims automation at [REDACTED_INSURTECH] from March 2023 through November 2025.

Built secure claim-intake and review services combining claim details, policy data, uploaded documents, customer notes, and status updates through cloud-hosted APIs. Developed AI-assisted claim review features for summarization, document extraction, missing-information detection, fraud-signal indicators, and routing recommendations. Implemented a retrieval-augmented internal assistant for policy rules, coverage conditions, partner guidelines, and operational documentation. Delivered React dashboard features for claim queues, review status, customer submissions, policy details, processing history, and reviewer workflows. Used PostgreSQL and Redis for claim records, cached policy data, workflow status, user sessions, and fast lookups. Deployed and monitored services on AWS with secure environment configuration, logging, monitoring, and CloudWatch alerts. Reduced API latency by up to 70 percent through query optimization, Redis caching, request validation, structured logging, retry logic, and monitoring. Evaluated AI output for summary accuracy, hallucination risk, missing-field detection, and human-review escalation. Worked with product, QA, and insurance operations to test edge cases and reduce manual review friction.

Full Stack Engineer with more than ten years of experience across fintech, insurance, and AI-enabled products.

Designed dashboard widgets for transaction volume, pending and failed payments, refunds, and settlement status.
